accepted_scope: scalar-principal mixed rank-4 Dirichlet and rank-12 Neumann reduced wave system
smooth variable-coefficient frozen construction by discrete elliptic Galerkin
finite-order linear estimates at orders 10 through 15 with stated low indices
compatible exact-jet Picard iteration at m14
strong top Sobolev time continuity and continuous data dependence
required_hypotheses: fixed positive product fiber metric and split-preserving connection
smooth background on the prescribed finite slab
state-dependent scalar principal coefficients without derivative dependence
positive time and spatial energy margins
boundary normal-tangential inverse metric components vanish
common initial open shell collar and protected precontact seed interval
excluded_claims: general finite-Sobolev restart existence at arbitrary nonzero shell corners
physical gauge and subsidiary interfaces without their separate proofs
top-norm differentiability of the solution map
external novelty, stability, Big Bang or publication conclusion
